title: Proof Route Cost Replay
description: Historical replay evidence comparing proof-route selection cost before and after a routed proof decision.

kind.description: Discriminator identifying this payload as proof-route cost replay evidence.

title.description: Human-readable title for the replay evidence.

status.description: Lifecycle state of this replay record.

issue.description: Issue number whose proof-route cost claim this replay supports.

source.description: Source archive, changed paths, and measurement boundary used to reconstruct the replay.

before.description: Proof selection and attributable cost before the routed proof decision.

after.description: Proof selection and attributable cost after the routed proof decision.

comparison.description: Derived comparison between the before and after proof selections.

exact_base_attribution.description: Exact repaired-base or baseline attribution facts that bound which findings belong to this issue.

proof_refs.description: Tests or proof references that support the replayed route decision.

claim_boundary.description: Explicit boundary for what this replay may and may not prove.

replay_side.description: One side of the proof-route replay comparison.

selection.description: Name or summary of the proof selection represented by this side.

subject_decisions.description: Per-subject rerun, reuse, or exclusion decisions that explain the selection.

attributable_summed_work_seconds.description: Total attributable work seconds assigned to this replay side.

attributable_critical_path_seconds.description: Attributable critical-path seconds assigned to this replay side.
